messages.subject: dplyr in Renjin
parts:
Hi Renjin

What a great project! However I have loads to scripts that depend on dplyr which is so useful in R. I can't imaging using R without dplyr and I know it is used a lot in the R community. DO you have any idea when the dependency bug for this package might be fixed. I'm sure it would be crucial for the uptake of the Renjin project, and of course for me :)

messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Re: dplyr in Renjin
parts:
Hi Sebastian,
Looks like dplyr is blocked now by a problem with asserthat that is probably a one line fix. The $<- operator needs to accept a character as well as a symbol for the name argument.

But beyond that, I don't really have a good idea as to what problems lie ahead - but it should be possible to get most of the functionality working with a bit of effort.

If you're willing to submit a few PRs, I'm happy to point you in the right direction!

Alex
